# Architecture Decision

## Backlog Item

Which item of the decision backlog (`docs/architecture_decisions/README.md`)
does this address? (e.g. D05)

## Context

Describe the architectural problem or decision area. State whether it narrows,
changes or departs from a commitment in the approved thesis proposal.

## Decision

Describe the proposed decision.

## Rationale

Why is this decision preferred?

## Alternatives Considered

List other options that were considered.

## Affected Areas

* [ ] requirements and performance targets
* [ ] simulator interface
* [ ] coordinate frames and conventions
* [ ] algorithm libraries
* [ ] cFS application structure
* [ ] Software Bus messages
* [ ] large data transport
* [ ] configuration/tables
* [ ] time and execution model
* [ ] observability and performance measurement
* [ ] evaluation and experiments
* [ ] vendor/cFS baseline
* [ ] documentation

## Impact

Describe expected impact on architecture, compatibility, testing, experiments
or future development.

## Open Questions

List unresolved questions, assumptions or risks.
